THE JOHNS HOPKINS HOSPITAL
Get Filings
This Charity is not available for public.

The Annual Filing Document Search website is intended as an informational tool only and is being made available as a public service. Please note that the AGO maintains fifteen (15) years of annual filing records, and that recently filed reports may not yet be available in the database. If a report does not appear in the database, it does not necessarily mean the public charity is delinquent or has failed to file the report. Questions regarding the availability of a report or the status of a public charity should be directed to the AGO’s Non-Profit Organizations/Public Charities Division by phone (617) 963-2101 or email at charities@mass.gov.

For information on registration and filing requirements, please return to the Non-Profit Organizations/Public Charities Division Main Page. Note that certain charities may be exempt from filing requirements under M.G.L. c. 12, §§ 8E and 8F, M.G.L. c. 68, §§ 19 and 20, and 940 CMR 2.00.

For information regarding the eligibility of any public charity to receive tax-deductible charitable contributions, please visit the Internal Revenue Service Tax Exempt Organization Search page at https://apps.irs.gov/app/eos/.
